scientific_limitations: Only three iid area-uniform sites on the unit two-sphere; a labelled typical cell, not a size-biased cell.
Classical cosine-kernel and spherical-halfspace ingredients are not asserted to be new.
Older relevant spherical tessellation literature from 1971 and 1994 was not inspectable in full; historical priority remains provisional.
Analytic proof is supplied; finite numerical experiments are corroborative only.
title: Exact area law for three-site spherical Voronoi cells
